title: Funnel Society Fabric
optimizationIntent: Take the Recursive Funnel Fabric and optimize it for effectively unbounded compositional growth: recursive child Funnels, heterogeneous solver societies, package ecosystems, horizontal scheduling, caching, sharding, compaction, experimentation and resource-aware expansion.
thesis: Treat every Funnel as a composable case node in a larger society; scale by adding resources and instances rather than rewriting central logic.

societyModel.structure: Recursive directed acyclic case graph with explicit parent/question edges.
societyModel.fanOut: Any material unresolved question may spawn N isolated solver tasks and/or M child FunnelCases.
societyModel.fanIn: Children return compact receipts; parents consume receipts rather than full child working memory.
societyModel.reuse: Identical content-addressed questions/packages/verified sub-results may be cached and reused when scope permits.
societyModel.heterogeneity: Worker/model/provider/seed mixes are configurable and tracked for correlation.
societyModel.replication: System packages can instantiate many times without cloning source code.
societyModel.locality: Cases can execute local-first, remote, or hybrid according to package/runtime policy.

scheduler.backpressure: New work waits or degrades gracefully when budget/parallelism thresholds are reached; raising the budget expands the same topology.
scheduler.faultRule: A failed job can retry, switch worker/provider, or return a failure receipt without blocking unrelated branches.

propositionSystem.job: Normalize independently worded worker answers into comparable propositions.

storageModel.hot: Active case state and current receipts.
storageModel.cold: Compacted verified history, representative disagreements, failure exemplars and audit roots.
storageModel.compaction: Keep content hashes and authority summaries while allowing disposable intermediate work to expire according to retention policy.

learning: Calibrate solver reliability from verified outcomes.
Calibrate question usefulness from whether answers changed decisions.
Calibrate package reliability from regression and execution history.
Learn worker correlation so nominally independent votes are not overcounted.
Preserve dissent that later proves correct.
foundryIntegration: Represent packages and cases as finite nodes/edges.
Expose worker count, recursion depth, fanout, convergence count and retention as sliders/knobs.
Allow templates for whole societies of Funnels.
Serialize architecture experiments as config rather than source-code forks.
